hook.name: Dot
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that fully handles ETH/token swaps via put (ETH→token, 30% vault fee stays in vault raising the floor price) and clear (token→ETH, 25% vault fee + 5% team fee) operations. Normal AMM liquidity is disabled. Requires 32 bytes of hookData encoding the swapper address. Auto-migrates all reserves to a full-range Uniswap V3 position when ETH reserves reach 100 ETH.
